answer_1.quote: Over the last several years, there has been a growing interest in applying machine learning (ML) models to code summarization tasks, such as comment generation and method naming.
datasets: popular and active open-source Java projects from GitHub

answer_2.quote: We used four automatic metrics that are frequently reported in prior work: BLEU (average sentence-level BLEU-4 with smoothing)), METEOR, ROUGE-L, and EM (exact match accuracy).
